# ToggleButtons { #anylumino.ToggleButtons }

```python
ToggleButtons(
    options=(),
    value=None,
    index=None,
    description='',
    disabled=False,
    variant='',
    tooltips=None,
    icons=None,
    icon_size='s',
    quiet=False,
    **kwargs,
)
```

Segmented toggle-button selection control.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name        | Type     | Description                                                                                                        | Default   |
|-------------|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| options     | optional | Selectable values or ``(label, value)`` pairs.                                                                     | `()`      |
| value       | optional | Initial value and synced Python value.                                                                             | `None`    |
| index       | optional | Selected option index.                                                                                             | `None`    |
| description | optional | Label shown above the control.                                                                                     | `''`      |
| disabled    | optional | Whether user interaction is disabled.                                                                              | `False`   |
| variant     | optional | Spectrum visual variant such as ``'accent'``, ``'primary'``, ``'negative'``, ``'positive'``, or ``'informative'``. | `''`      |
| tooltips    | optional | Per-option tooltips.                                                                                               | `None`    |
| icons       | optional | Spectrum workflow icon names or per-option icon dictionaries for toggle-button options.                            | `None`    |
| icon_size   | optional | Spectrum icon size such as ``'s'``, ``'m'``, ``'l'``, ``'xl'``, or ``'xxl'``.                                      | `'s'`     |
| quiet       | optional | Whether to use Spectrum's quiet visual treatment.                                                                  | `False`   |

## Attributes

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [control_kind](#anylumino.ToggleButtons.control_kind) | A trait for unicode strings. |
